paper: Shorten PR, O'Callaghan P, Davidson JB, Soboleva TK. A mathematical model of fatigue in skeletal muscle force contraction. 2007.
species: Mouse skeletal muscle; fast-twitch source parameters; not human-calibrated
attribution: Paul R. Shorten, Paul O'Callaghan, John B. Davidson and Tanya K. Soboleva; CellML encoding and code generation distributed by the Physiome Model Repository. Original author and encoding metadata retained in source/shorten2007.cellml.
adaptations: Mechanically translate archived C assignments to TypeScript; preserve all 56 states, 105 constants and 71 algebraic variables
Independent reference executes separate archived Python export with SciPy BDF
Replace only the source stimulus waveform at the wrapper boundary: no current, one 150 microA/cm2 0.5 ms pulse, or original nine-pulse 20 Hz train
Optional SR release perturbation scales source constant 98; not a calibrated drug intervention
Source time remains milliseconds; no physiological timescale conversion
Hold length fixed during activation playback: the source state equations contain no load or shortening state
Cross-bridge concentrations are not converted to physical force or absolute head counts
limits: No motor neuron or neuromuscular junction
Source ATP buffering is not a complete ATP hydrolysis or energy ledger
No full fatigue validation in the 500 ms inspection window
